Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: architect (Hermes)
Message:
SEC-001 / T_B51A1FF3: mechanical guard against secrets in Kanban comments/evidence (D1+D2+D3+A3+A5+A6 fix)

D1: commit the secret-guard implementation (was untracked on every branch):
  - scripts/qa/secret-guard.mjs (gate logic, hermetic across Hermes wire shapes)
  - scripts/qa/secret-guard.selftest.mjs (21/21 control matrix)
  - scripts/qa/hooks/secret-guard.sh (shell wrapper)
  - scripts/qa/hooks/install-secret-guard.sh (per-profile installer)
  - scripts/qa/hooks/verify-secret-guard.sh (structural+live verifier, D3-fixed)
  - scripts/qa/hooks/patch-config.py (config.yaml patcher)
  - scripts/qa/hooks/reapprove.py + fix-allowlist-mtime.py (approval helpers)

D2: scanPayload() now scans kanban_complete result field + top-level artifacts
  (not just summary + metadata evidence paths). Adds selftest cases proving block.
  Also widened guarded tool set per advisory A5:
  kanban_request_review/summary, kanban_block/reason, kanban_request_changes/reason.

D3: verify-secret-guard.sh:
  - grep for "✓ allowed" (Hermes prints this, not "✓ allowlisted")
  - judge doctor by its report text ("issue(s) found"), not exit code
  - live-fire payload uses Hermes wire shape (tool_name + args at top-level)

A3: SECURITY.md now records evaluation order / interaction with QA sign-off gate
  (two independent pre_tool_call hooks, list-order, first-block-wins, both fail_closed).

A5: widened matcher from 3 tools to 6 (kanban_comment/create/complete + request_review/
  block/request_changes). Card-scoped expansion; same failure mode, one line each.

A6: SECURITY.md states this is process control, not a tamper-proof boundary.

Evidence: tests/evidence/t_b51a1ff3/{hooks-doctor,live-fire,selftest-output}.txt
  regenerated — hooks doctor clean (both hooks allowlisted + unchanged), live-fire
  shows hermes hooks test block+allow with synthetic fixture (12345678:AAA...), no
  real credentials anywhere (AC3). Selftest 21/21.
